messages:
maya: Heads-up — incident alert from monitoring: autoscaler failures in eu-west-1, spike in pod OOMs at 13:12 UTC. I pinned the release window and the deploy bot paused the rollout.
deploy-bot: Deploy halted: reason=region:euw1_autoscaler_error, action=hold, triggered_by=monitoring, canary_status=paused. See /incidents/INC-2026-0321.
sre-oncall: Confirming — we're seeing kube-scheduler backoff + eviction churn on the canaries. Logs show liveness probe restarts.
leo: Any quick mitigation? We can rollback the canary or scale down replicas to stop the churn while we investigate.
vijay: Suggest partial rollback only for eu-west-1 canary instance. Keep other zones green.
anna: I'm worried about config drift — if we rollback, we should pin the image tag so the next deploy doesn't re-trigger. Can we do a sticky pin for the current stable sha?
maya: Yes. Plan A: rollback canary in euw1 -> pin stable image for that zone -> rerun health checks. If good, reschedule staggered rollout for other zones next change window.
leo: Command I'll run if we agree: `deployctl rollback --cluster=euw1 --deployment=api-canary --to-tag=redwood/api@sha256:9f2a`
sre-oncall: +1. I'll watch for OOM patterns after rollback. If OOMs persist, we'll toggle the liveness timeout and collect heap profiles.
deploy-bot: Action recorded: hold placed by monitoring. Suggested next windows: 2026-03-21T02:00Z (low traffic), 2026-03-21T09:00Z (EU morning). Please confirm preferred.
release-manager: We need a short release note update saying "Canary rollback in eu-west-1 due to autoscaler instability; staggered rollout rescheduled." I'll prep the blurb but hold off until action is decided.
vijay: Go for 02:00Z. Stagger across zones: euw1 (rollback + pin) -> euw2 (canary attempt) -> global. Keep 15m observation between stages.
anna: I'll open a tiny PR to pin the image tag and add an ops note in the changelog. Link: https://git.redwood/ops/pins/PR-784
maya: leo — please run the rollback now. anna/vijay/sre-oncall will monitor.
leo: Running rollback. Output: ```kubectl rollout undo deployment/api-canary --namespace=production-euw1
deployment.apps/api-canary rolled back to revision 42
```
sre-oncall: Seeing pod count stabilize, evictions falling. Liveness probe failures dropped to 0 in the last 2m.
deploy-bot: Hold still active. Next automated action: resume when owner=eng-releases approves.
release-manager: Drafted release note: "Paused rollout in eu-west-1 after autoscaler-induced canary instability; canary rolled back and image pinned; staggered retry scheduled 2026-03-21T02:00Z." Posting to release channel when rollout resumes.
maya: Thanks. Action items: (1) leo confirm rollback complete (done), (2) anna merge pin PR, (3) vijay validate euw1 metrics for 30m, (4) release-manager prepare changelog entry. If metrics stable at 13:45 UTC we'll set the new change window to 02:00Z and allow deploy-bot to run staged rollout.
anna: PR merged and pinned: redwood/api@sha256:9f2a.
vijay: Metrics look stable at +25m. No further OOMs.
maya: Great — closing the incident hold. @deploy-bot please schedule staggered rollout for 2026-03-21T02:00Z with 15m pause between zones and canary in euw2 first.
deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled: start=2026-03-21T02:00Z, strategy=staggered-zones, pause_between_zones=15m, canary_zone=euw2. Hold will be automatically removed 10m before start.
leo: I'll be on standby during the window.
sre-oncall: I'll be on-call for the night shift. Ping if anything spikes.
release-manager: Release note queued and ready to post after successful global rollout.
maya: Closing thread — thanks team :thumbsup:
